environment.description: Kubernetes pod with gVisor (runsc) runtime class configured with restricted platform (systrap). Container filesystem overlay has an AppArmor profile (k8s-upload-restrict) that confines write(2) syscalls to paths matching /var/app/uploads/** and /tmp/** only — the profile uses 'deny /** w' as base with explicit 'allow /var/app/uploads/** w' and 'allow /tmp/** w' owner rules. Additionally, the container runs with a seccomp profile that filters openat(2) calls where the resolved path after symlink resolution does not begin with /var/app/uploads/ or /tmp/ (custom BPF filter using SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO). The pgBouncer instance uses prepared statement protocol with server_lifetime=300 and query parameterization enforced at the pooler level.

config.apparmor_profile: k8s-upload-restrict: deny /** w, allow /var/app/uploads/** w, allow /tmp/** w
config.seccomp_profile: custom BPF: openat filtered to /var/app/uploads/** and /tmp/**
config.pgbouncer: prepared statement protocol mode, parameterization enforced
config.network_policy: egress only to pgbouncer:6432, ingress only from ingress-controller
